deployable_note: deployable:true means ACTIVELY TRADING IN SANDBOX (futures_follow precedent) — there is no scaffold/observe-only default state; it does NOT mean cleared for live. Live would additionally need the strategy_mode flip + the platform-global gate.

params.selection: top-3 gainers long / top-3 losers short by 09:15-open vs prev daily close
params.trade_side_note: UI-configurable (issue #503): both | long_only | short_only. Gates selection, so an excluded side is never watched. The parity_target below is a BOTH-sides measurement — a one-sided day is not comparable to it.
params.shadow_note: UI-configurable (issue #581), DEFAULT OFF. When on AND trade_side is one-sided, the EXCLUDED side is watched and triggered exactly as the traded side is, and NO ORDER IS EVER PLACED for it. Rows carry fill='shadow' priced at the full slot size (not the 1-lot sim convention) so the two cohorts are comparable; quantity stays 0 because nothing was ordered. A FOURTH P&L bucket, never summed into real/paper/sim, excluded from total_realized_pnl and so from compound sizing. Own cap shadow_max_trades - shadow rows never consume max_trades. Both seed and rolling additions are shadowed. NOTE this strategy is LIVE (real money) since 2026-07-24, which is why the excluded side is measured this way rather than switched on: July parity had the short side at -Rs2,485 / 20% win rate (options) and -Rs143 (stock).
params.rolling_watchlist_note: UI-configurable (issue #529), DEFAULT OFF. When on, the universe is re-ranked on live LTP every rolling_cadence_s (clamped 10-300) inside the entry window and the top-N movers per side are APPENDED to the watch list — additive only, entry gate and max_trades cap unchanged. Trades carry watch_source in {seed, rolling}. MEASUREMENT, not a validated edge: the 2026-08-03 replay showed the 09:16 ranking misses the day's biggest movers but produced only 3 incremental trades (+Rs162, 1 win of 3) on 4 usable days. The parity_target below is a SEED-cohort measurement — a day with rolling adds is not comparable to it.
params.vol_baseline: running average of completed minute volumes since 09:15 (auction included in v0)
params.entry: mid-bar tick trigger: cumvol-in-minute >= vol_mult x baseline AND ltp beyond first-candle level
params.exit: hard flatten 09:30:00 IST, retry 09:32; no stop, no target

honest_context: Round 58: bar-level versions of this signal have NO honest edge (close entry -0.16%/trade; the published +0.38% was entry-level look-ahead). This sandbox run measures whether the legal mid-bar entry captures enough of the ~0.54% intra-bar burst. Decision rule: trigger entry must beat close entry by >=0.4pp/trade over ~30+ signals, else final REJECT.

options_variant.note: ATM 28-JUL monthly buys, production option-mode sizing floor(30k/(premium*lot)), real broker 1m premiums, production charge model (no bid-ask haircut); 2 signals unaffordable (MANAPPURAM 07-01, GVT&D 07-02, both shorts); NATIONALUM 07-23 alone is +7,583 of the total. long/short split recomputed from the r59_trades.json 30k-slot dump (issue #458) — July's entire edge was the long side

parity_target.caveat: Single-month window; annualized CAGR/Sharpe indicative only. R58 full-history honest edge remains -0.16%/trade - July is one favourable month, not a validation.

ops: App must boot before 09:15 IST; late boot = day skipped (loud WARNING).
